WORKABOUTES / EN

PIXEL ARTIST AND ANIMATOR.

I'm Kevin Medina, also known as IMNOTAPAN. I create pixel art characters, worlds and animation for games, music, brands and digital projects, with a strong focus on building visuals with personality and a recognizable identity.

My work spans character design, animation, environments and visual development, from early exploration through final production.

Across different projects, my work has been part of music videos and digital productions with more than 27 million combined views, contributing to pieces for artists and creators such as Carre & Spreen, Marcianeke, Le'Kays and Rodi Garrido.

I also have a background in Computer Engineering, which lets me move comfortably between the artistic and technical sides of a production, integrating smoothly into pipelines and development teams.

I currently work as a background and tileset artist on Hayaku! Island of Darkness and I am open to collaborating with studios, brands, agencies and creative teams on new projects.
